field_principles.paired_effect_rows: Reports held charged effects for each router arm versus the Exp6544 certified structural control.
field_principles.family_and_effort_effect_rows: Reports family, effort, abstention-bin, negative, and no-headroom cells from rows.
field_principles.charged_cost_recomputation: Recomputes model, lookup, proposal, exact-check, fallback, and total charged work from rows.
field_principles.exact_equality_and_fallback_receipt: Shows exact equality, full candidate preservation, and reachable native exact fallback.

field_principles.rollback_receipt: Declares the structural-control rollback path and proves unsafe router states close to score zero.
field_principles.external_safety_net_ready_score: Opens only for a frozen eligible router with held charged value, exact equality, calibrated abstention, train-only immutable exceptions, reachable fallback, and no shortcut failure.

field_principles.aggregate_row_recomputation: Rebuilds the verdict and ready score from gate, row, cost, equality, fallback, calibration, exception, attack, and rollback receipts.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Records paths, hashes, CPU, GPU, seeds, budgets, timeouts, protected hashes, and exact-solver authority.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: Shows guarded inputs, specs, prior artifacts, and conductor files stayed byte-identical during the run.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares local compact router training with train-only exceptions and external exact fallback, with no LLM.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False because router value is measured and Z3 is the separate evaluation authority.

field_principles.random_seed: Pins model fitting, evaluation seeds, table hashing, and attack ordering.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Detects drift in gates, models, tables, rows, costs, attacks, rollback, and verdicts.
